**Be part of something groundbreaking**

At AIG, we are making long-term investments in a brand-new, innovative Generative AI team, designed to explore new possibilities for how artificial intelligence can be applied in insurance and beyond, and we need your help.

With the support and investment needed to explore new frontiers in generative AI, you’ll be working alongside talented colleagues, innovating and leading projects that will transform how we manage risk and serve our customers.

This team is central to our vision of the future and the core of our business offering. We will incorporate best-in-class engineering and product management principles and your guidance and collaboration will be critical to its success. To rapidly advance and innovate, we need your skills and expertise to build and scale world-class products. If you’re excited by the opportunity to create meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you.

**Who we are**

AIG is a leading global insurance organization providing a wide range of property casualty insurance and other financial services. We provide world-class products and expertise to businesses and individuals in approximately 190 countries and jurisdictions.

At AIG, we’re reshaping how the world manages risk, and we’re inviting you to be a key part of that transformation.

**How you will create impact**

As a **Data Scientist** at AIG, you will serve a critical role in the architecture, development, and delivery of impactful enterprise-level Generative AI solutions. We are seeking a highly technical individual contributor with extensive hands-on experience, as we are an applied data science team operating in an agile and production-oriented environment. You will be focused on Large Language Models (LLMs) and Machine Learning (ML), acting as a primary technical driver for our most complex projects.

**Your Responsibilities**

* End-to-End Development: Lead the development and successful delivery of data science and generative AI solutions in accordance with business requirements.
    
* Production Oversight: Monitor solutions in production to ensure performance, reliability, and accuracy.
    
* Technical Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional teams including product managers, engineers, and business leaders to translate requirements into technical reality.
    
* Evaluation & Quality: Build robust evaluation frameworks to measure LLM efficacy, manage ground truth dataset quality, and guide the product development roadmap.
    
* Architecture: Design scalable ML pipelines and RAG frameworks that integrate seamlessly with enterprise data structures.
    

**What is Needed to be Successful**

* 8+ years of Engineering Experience in a development environment
    
* 6+ years of experience in a data science role, with a strong emphasis on NLP and ML, working in an agile production-oriented environment.
    
* 3+ years of practical experience with open-source Large Language Models (Llama 3, Mixtral, etc.), including prompt engineering, inference optimization, and fine-tuning.
    
* 3+ years of experience building Generative AI Solutions, including designing and building RAG frameworks, validation pipelines, observability, and monitoring solutions.
    
* Proven Delivery: Experience successfully delivering multiple GenAI, analytical, or ML projects from conception through to production.
    
* Python Expertise: Strong, expert-level proficiency in Python and its data science ecosystem (e.g., PyTorch, Pandas, Scikit-learn).
    
* Education: Master’s degree in data science, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
    

**Added Bonus / Preferred Qualifications**

* Palantir Platform Experience: Hands-on experience or certification in the Palantir platform (Foundry/AIP).
    
* Ontology Mastery: A strong understanding of Ontology—specifically how to map complex real-world data entities and relationships into a digital twin framework to power AI applications.
    
* Large-scale Data Infrastructure: Strong understanding of performance optimization in big data environments, with hands-on experience using distributed data processing frameworks such as Apache Spark or PySpark.
    
* Agentic Solution: Experience implementing advanced agentic architectures, such as autonomous agents capable of multi-step reasoning and decision-making or integrating agentic solutions with large-scale enterprise systems.
    

**Required Competencies**

* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment.
    
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
    
* A "hands-on" mindset with the desire to be a primary technical lead through code quality and architectural excellence.
    

Ready to set new industry standards? We would love to hear from you.

Veterans are encouraged to apply.

At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.

We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging through learning, cultural awareness activities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). Why UKG:
At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.
We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
About the team
Our Go-to-Market Data Science team turns UKG workforce data into insights that help customers and business leaders understand their workforce. We develop benchmarks, conduct applied research, and partner with economists, Communications, Product, and Engineering to connect what happens in the flow of work with broader labor market trends.
About the role
We are seeking a Principal Larbor Market Data Scientist to lead hands-on research and analysis focused on labor and workforce insights. As a senior individual contributor, you will own work from defining the question and investigating the data through validating findings and explaining their significance to business leaders.
This role is dedicated to supporting UKG senior leaders, Corporate Communications, and our labor economists with evidence for executive-to-executive discussions, media interviews, press releases, and thought leadership. Working closely with our economist colleagues, you will combine UKG workforce data with external labor market sources to develop timely insights that inform executive discussions and external communications. You will bring the technical depth to build the analysis and the judgment to determine what the evidence supports.
Responsibilities
+ Partner with labor economists and Communications to define research questions and produce validated analyses, charts, and supporting materials for executive briefings, customer discussions, and media preparation.
+ Lead original research on hiring, separations, hours worked, wages, labor supply, and other workforce trends. Identify questions that matter to employers and workers, and investigate changes across industries, geographies, and workforce segments.
+ Deliver executive briefings, charts, talking points, and supporting analysis for customer discussions and media engagements.
+ Excellent written and verbal communication, with experience translating quantitative findings into concise, accurate materials for leaders, business audiences, or public use.
+ Own the analytical response to urgent executive and media questions. Clarify the question, assess feasibility, and deliver findings with the context and limitations needed to use them accurately.
+ Combine large-scale UKG workforce data with public and commercial labor data. Evaluate source definitions, coverage, reporting lags, and comparability before drawing conclusions.
+ Develop and validate statistical methods for workforce indicators, trends, and comparisons. Address seasonality, changing employer populations, missing data, revisions, and sampling bias; distinguish workforce changes from data artifacts and association from causation.
+ Build reproducible analysis and recurring reporting workflows using SQL and Python. Maintain documented methods, versioned code, and automated checks so results can be reproduced, reviewed, and updated efficiently.
+ Review the numerical accuracy and interpretation of findings, charts, and proposed public claims. Explain uncertainty, challenge unsupported conclusions, and recommend when findings need further analysis before use.
+ Partner with Product, Engineering, and data owners to resolve source issues and improve the datasets supporting workforce insights. Apply appropriate privacy protections and aggregation standards in collaboration with Legal and privacy teams.
+ Provide technical leadership and mentor data scientists through research design, code review, and stakeholder discussions. Lead substantial workstreams independently and communicate priorities, tradeoffs, and delivery risks clearly.
Basic qualifications
+ Bachelor’s degree or higher in statistics, data science, economics, computer science, mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
+ 8+ years of relevant experience in data science, applied statistics, quantitative research, or a related field, with demonstrated ownership of complex analytical work and influence at a senior level.
+ Substantial hands-on experience analyzing labor market or workforce data in recent professional roles, including producing research, indicators, or insights from employment, payroll, wage, hours, job posting, or worker-level datasets.
+ Deep applied statistical expertise, including time-series analysis, sampling and weighting, hypothesis testing, and uncertainty estimation. Ability to select methods appropriate to the data and question.
+ Strong SQL and Python skills, including the ability to work independently with large, complex datasets and build maintainable, reproducible analytical workflows.
+ Demonstrated ability to assess data quality and representativeness, reconcile inconsistent sources, and explain how methodological choices affect conclusions.
+ Ability to explain analytical findings, methods, and limitations clearly to technical and nontechnical colleagues and collaborate on materials for business audiences.
+ Ability to lead ambiguous research assignments independently, collaborate with economists and technical partners, and deliver sound analysis under time-sensitive conditions.
Preferred qualifications
+ Master’s or PhD in a relevant quantitative discipline.
+ Recent experience developing labor market research, indicators, or data products at a statistical agency, payroll provider, workforce analytics organization, or comparable research institution.
+ Experience supporting corporate communications, economic publications, executive briefings, or media preparation, including reviewing research for public release.
+ Experience with econometrics, forecasting, or causal inference applied to labor and workforce questions.
+ Experience with Google Cloud Platform and BigQuery, workforce management or human capital management data, and recurring labor market indicators or benchmark publications.

That’s why more than 80,000 organizations worldwide trust UKG to run their workforce — not just manage it. Learn more at ukg.com.

Position Description & Qualifications
Serco-NA is seeking a motivated Data Scientist to join our team supporting a program focused on Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM). The successful candidate will contribute to the development of data-driven insights and analytic solutions that help identify, assess, and mitigate risks in complex supply chains.
Must be able obtain a U.S. Department of War (DoW) Secret security clearance.
This position operates in a fast-paced environment requiring daily interaction with suppliers, government stakeholders, and industry partners. You must be a self-starter capable of independently identifying issues, analyzing complex datasets, developing actionable insights, and communicating performance outcomes to senior leadership.
Working remotely, you will be on the dynamic SIB Data Team providing support to the Program Manager and DRPM SUB where you will help manage a dynamic mix of in-house development teams and third-party tool integration projects to deliver solutions that support the SIB program. Bring your expertise and collaborative skills to make an impact on our military defense and safety of our sailors.
Program Overview
The Submarine Industrial Base (SIB) Program leads the U.S. Navy's effort to revitalize America's shipbuilding and repair capabilities. Established in September 2024, the program strengthens and expands the industrial base that builds and maintains surface ships, aircraft carriers, and submarines vital to national defense.
https://www.secnav.navy.mil/rda/mib/Pages/default.aspx
DRPM Subs is responsible for:
+ The acquisition of COLUMBIA Class Submarines, including R&D, design, construction, Test and Evaluation (T&E), and Live Fire Test and Evaluation (LFT&E). This program is a major defense acquisition effort with significant Congressional and OSD visibility.
+ The acquisition of VIRGINIA Class Submarines, including lifecycle management, T&E, LFT&E, and Fleet introduction, with an estimated lifecycle cost of ~$336B.
+ The SSN(X) program, responsible for next-generation fast attack submarine design and acquisition, emphasizing speed, stealth, payload capacity, and operational endurance.
Serco supports the US Navy as prime for SHAPM contract supporting the acquisition of submarines and surface vessels.
In this role, you will:
+ Develop and implement data science solutions to analyze large and complex datasets related to supply chain networks.
+ Designs, develops and implements the most valuable business solutions for the organization.
+ Apply statistical methods, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and predictive modeling to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential risks.
+ Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code in Python leveraging data science libraries (e.g., pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow).
+ Query, manipulate, and analyze structured and unstructured data from databases (SQL, NoSQL, Hive, etc.).
+ Support data ingestion, processing, and visualization workflows to deliver actionable insights to government stakeholders.
+ Prepares big data, implements data models and develop database to support the business solutions.
+ Present findings through reports, dashboards, and briefings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
+ Identifies business trends and problems through complex big data analysis.
+ Collaborate with a cross-functional team of analysts, data engineers, front-end developers, and subject matter experts to deliver mission-critical solutions.
+ Present findings through reports, dashboards, and briefings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
+ Interprets results from multiple sources using a variety of techniques, ranging from simple data aggregation via statistical analysis to complex data mining independently.
+ Work with the SIB team, which is spread across the United States focused on workforce development/marketing, supply chain/sustainment, and technology developments.
+ Occasionally directed in several aspects of the work.
+ Interact with industry and senior leadership.
+ Gain exposure to some of the complex tasks within the job function.
To be successful in this role, you will have:
+ Able to obtain a DoW Secret security clearance.
+ U.S. citizenship is required.
+ Bachelor’s in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.
+ 2 years of hands-on experience in data science, analytics, or applied machine learning.
+ Strong proficiency in Python and core data science libraries.
+ Experience with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL) for querying and analysis.
+ Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical insights clearly.
+ The ability to travel 10%.
Nice to Have:
+ Background or coursework in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or Risk Analysis.
+ Experience with big data tools (Hadoop, Spark, Hive, etc.).
+ Familiarity with government contracting or defense-related projects.
+ Experience developing in Cloudera Data Science Workbench (CDSW).

About Reserv
Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement
Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

As a Senior Data Scientist at Reserv, you will help guide the trajectory of our data offering and drive growth for years to come. You will play a crucial role on our data science team, collaborating directly with the business to understand our customer’s areas of analytical interest and build modeling to explore these. This position is ideal for a data scientist with a solid foundation in predictive modeling and data analysis and an innovative mindset ready to shape the future of one of the key components of our value proposition.

Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct hypothesis driven analyses across our customer’s multiple claims portfolios and surface trends that can be leveraged to improve claims outcomes

• Guide the creation and implementation of both heuristic and complex predictive models, adhering to the principle of "Occam’s Razor."

• Build and maintain software tools that allow us to scale our insight generation capabilities

• Collaborate with our customer facing teams to empirically ground our perspective on market trends and insights

• Mentor junior data scientists and support analysts at customer companies.

• Communicate technical ideas and specifications clearly and precisely to non technical audiences.

• Continuously deploy code from day one, influencing and enhancing our engineering culture.

• Engage with cross-functional teams including product ops, design, and sales as our product and engineering teams expand.

Qualifications:

• 10+ years of experience as a data scientist with a robust portfolio demonstrating high-quality analysis and modeling.

• Experience in running end-to-end experiments, including setting up datasets, developing controls, conducting hypothesis tests, running ablation studies, and rigorously evaluating outcomes.

• Expertise in Python and relevant data science libraries as well as with agentic coding tools

• Strong software engineering foundation with a commitment to delivering high-quality, maintainable, and well-tested code

• Proven ability to stay updated with state-of-the-art techniques through continuous research and application.

• Strong ability to prioritize customer requirements and adapt quickly to evolving project scopes.

• Passionate about creating intuitive technology solutions and a continuous desire to learn and take on new challenges.

Benefits

• Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental

• 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching

• Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!

• Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work

• 100% remote (home-based) role designed to support your work-life balance

• Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

Amplio is building the intelligence layer that powers how manufacturers recover value from surplus equipment. You’ll lead the development of our appraisal and pricing capabilities — combining data science with agentic AI to automate and improve valuation decisions at scale.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and iterate models that estimate fair market value, recovery potential, and optimal disposition strategy.
* Leverage agentic AI to automate cataloging and appraisal workflows.
* Support Sales to underwrite buyout offers and predict consignment recovery and capacity utilization.
* Build feedback loops for continuous price optimization and model refinement.
* Collaborate with Product and Ops to turn insights into high-impact pricing and sourcing actions.

**Requirements**

**What You Bring**

* 4–8+ years in data science, analytics, or preferably pricing within marketplaces, logistics, or asset-heavy environments.
* Strong modeling and experimentation skills (Python, SQL, Bayesian / probabilistic modeling).
* Comfort operating with limited data — capable of building and validating proxy-based models.
* Blend of technical depth and business intuition; fluent in assumptions, risk, and real-world tradeoffs.
* Curiosity for manufacturing, recommerce, and the circular economy.
